description: This minor course enriches students with various AI techniques and makes them familiar with the applicability, strengths and weaknesses of basic knowledge representation, problem-solving, machine learning, knowledge acquisition and learning methods for solving engineering problems.

syllabus.title: Introduction
syllabus.body: Concept of AI, history, current status, scope, reactive, deliberative, goal-driven, utility-driven and learning agents, environments and problem formulation.

syllabus.title: Learning Deterministic Models
syllabus.body: Supervised learning algorithms, regression - simple and multiple linear regression, underfitting, overfitting and cross validation, parameter estimation for simple linear regression, gradient descent optimization and its variants.

syllabus.title: Statistical Learning and Data Clustering
syllabus.body: Bayes theorem, general Bayes theorem, Naive Bayes classifier, Bayesian belief networks, k-nearest neighbor classifier, linear regression with least square error criterion, minimal sum-of-error-squares and the pseudo-inverse, least mean square (LMS) algorithm, partitional, hierarchical and spectral clustering, clustering using self-organizing maps, K-means clustering.

syllabus.title: Convolutional and Recurrent Neural Networks
syllabus.body: Image classification, text classification, hyper-parameter tuning, emerging NN architectures, building recurrent NNs, Long Short-Term Memory, time series forecasting, case studies involving AI applications in engineering problem solving.

outcomes: Understand the fundamentals and development of AI.
Acquire knowledge of various strategies for AI systems.
Analyze basic and advanced search techniques.
Apply CNN and RNN for various applications.
textbooks: E. Rich, K. Knight and B. Nair, Artificial Intelligence, Tata McGraw Hills, 3rd Edition, 2009.
G. F. Luger, Artificial Intelligence: Structures and Strategies for Complex Problem Solving, Pearson Education Asia, 6th Edition, 2009.
M. Gopal, Applied Machine Learning, McGraw-Hill Education, 2019.
referenceBooks: R. E. Neapolitan and X. Jiang, Artificial Intelligence: With an Introduction to Machine Learning, CRC Press, 2018.
S. Haykin, Neural Networks and Learning Machines, 3rd Edition, Pearson Education India, 2009.
